messages.text: Pulled a PortfolioMgr screen for tax-loss candidates ahead of Q3 reviews. Quite a few lots underwater in the tech and REIT sleeves. Want me to post a summary or is it too early in the year to bother?
Not too early. Harvesting in July/Aug gives us room to avoid wash-sale headaches before year-end. Which accounts are you seeing the biggest unrealized losses in?

Biggest one is {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0187}}'s brokerage, {{ACCOUNT_NUMBER:a_00387}}. A couple of lots in a broad REIT ETF bought last winter, roughly $18K unrealized loss combined. Low risk profile so a like-for-like swap should work.
That's my client. I'm fine with the harvest, but I want to check for dividend reinvestment in the cash_management side first. If anything auto-buys the same ETF we trip wash sale.
Good catch. DRIP is the usual culprit. Also check whether the spouse or any IRA holds the same fund, since that counts too.
Checked ClientHub, no linked IRA for them on our books. DRIP is off on {{ACCOUNT_NUMBER:a_00387}}. I'll note in the file that outside accounts are unknown and need the client to confirm.

Replacement idea for the REIT sleeve: swap into a different index provider's real estate fund, similar exposure but not substantially identical. I'll draft the rationale for the file and loop in the portfolio manager.
Make sure the rationale says we're not giving tax advice, just flagging. Client should confirm with their CPA. Also gains offset: do they have realized gains this year to use the losses against?
Yes, they sold a concentrated position in March, so there's a meaningful gain to offset. I'll call {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0187}} tomorrow morning to walk through it before we trade anything.

Also flagging {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0088}}, {{ACCOUNT_NUMBER:a_00187}}. Smaller loss, around $4K, probably not worth the trading cost and drift. Michael Castillo is the RM so I'll just pass it along to him as FYI.
Agree on skipping unless there are gains to offset. Let Michael decide. Put it in a short note instead of a full workup.
Will do. I'll save the full screen to the shared folder and tag both accounts in ClientHub so the notes are tracked. Posting the link here once it's up.
